requirements.statement: World Intelligence produces immutable source/artifact/observation/provenance lineage.
TADS consumes validated evidence and detects signals without treating signals as purchase predictions.
TADS opportunity scoring preserves evidence identifiers and explicit uncertainty.
SDEA consumes signal identifiers and creates a demand hypothesis with explicit confidence and rationale.
Capability need and opportunity retain evidence lineage back to the original observation/artifact.
SDEA recommendations remain advisory and cannot authorize consequential execution.
Untrusted external content is treated as data and never as executable instruction.
Cross-repository execution is performed against pinned reviewed revisions.
Post-phase forensic audit verifies implementation, authority boundaries, lineage and CI.
